citations.C4: `price` as currency string ("$12.34", "1,234.56") → ValueError; fix: strip currency symbols/thousands separators before parsing
citations.C6: Float binary rounding on money (`float(r['price'])`) → cumulative cent drift; fix: use `Decimal(r['price'])`
citations.C7: Negative `price` or `qty` (returns/refunds vs bad data) → silently accepted
citations.C8: NaN/Inf strings ("nan", "inf") parse successfully via float() → poisons total silently
citations.C9: One bad row aborts the entire aggregation with no indication which row → fix: catch per-row, collect/report failing row indices
